title: Atmospheric Pollution Reactor Simulation
description: Users operate a photochemical smog simulation where the LittlestTokyo cityscape represents an urban environment emitting pollutants, and the godrays model visualizes solar radiation driving atmospheric reactions. Players must adjust UV intensity, inject specific reagent gases, set temperature and humidity parameters, then trigger catalytic reactions to study ozone formation and decomposition cycles over the miniature city.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load LittlestTokyo.glb scaled to fit a 10-unit bounding box centered at origin as the urban pollution source. Load godrays_demo.glb positioned above and angled downward to represent solar radiation hitting the city. Add a semi-transparent dome (SphereGeometry, MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 0.3) enclosing both models to represent the atmospheric reaction chamber. Create a right-side HTML control panel with: (1) a UV Intensity slider 0-100 that adjusts the godrays model emissive brightness and a DirectionalLight intensity, (2) a dropdown to select reagent gas injection from NO2, SO2, VOC, and O3 each adding differently colored particle systems (brown, yellow, green, blue) using BufferGeometry points floating inside the dome, (3) a temperature slider 250K-350K that changes dome material color tint from blue to red, (4) a humidity slider 0-100% that adjusts dome opacity, (5) a Catalyze button that triggers an animation blending particle colors over 3 seconds simulating chemical reaction products, and (6) a Reset button clearing all particles and restoring defaults. Validate that UV must be above 40, a reagent must be selected, temperature must be 280-320K, and humidity above 30% before catalysis can trigger, otherwise show an alert with the missing condition. Use PerspectiveCamera at position (15,10,15) looking at origin. Add ambient light intensity 0.4 and hemisphere light. Play any animations from LittlestTokyo using AnimationMixer. Track reaction count in a visible counter. After 3 successful distinct reagent reactions, display a completion banner. OrbitControls should allow full rotation with damping enabled.
